data.title: 时崎狂三 · 旧书店午后
data.description: 旧书店的彩玻璃窗旁，狂三身着黑色高领衬衫与酒红百褶中裙，左手托住泛黄画册的书脊，右手轻掀一页。窗台近处堆着几本布面旧书，画册下面露出一枚压平的书签；身后窄书架与靠架木梯之间留出通往店内的过道。午后斜阳透过红与琥珀色窗格，把淡淡色块落在象牙白袖口与画页上，书架内层仍留在温暖的阴影里——「过去的记忆总是这般厚重而脆弱。不过，与您一同度过的这段时间，倒是非常值得放进书页里珍藏呢。」
data.location: 旧书店彩玻璃窗台旁，窄书架间可见通向店内的过道
data.action: 倚着窗台，左手托住旧画册书脊，右手掀起单页一角，低头专注阅读。
data.lighting: slanting afternoon light through red and amber stained glass; colored patches on cuffs and pages
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, supported album, window sill and shelf aisle visible
data.promptProse: Red and amber window panes lay muted rectangles of color across the old bookstore's sill. Kurumi leans against it in a black high-neck blouse with ivory cuffs and a burgundy pleated skirt, absorbed in a yellowed art album. Her left hand supports the spine while her right lifts one page corner. Clothbound volumes are stacked along the near sill, with a flat bookmark protruding below the album. A wooden ladder rests against the tall shelf behind her, and the narrow aisle remains visible between successive rows of books. Use an eye-level medium view that includes both hands. Slanting afternoon light picks out the ivory cuff and worn paper edges; stacked books cast overlapping shadows, while the inner shelves fall into warm darkness around her dark hair.
